description:
DONE s346 (gen v2-106). The E4.1 pre-work half: a `&`-prototype block-form arg (try/catch, first, reduce) no longer routes through v1's parse_block_as_function with $return_lambda=0 (which emitted a top-level --anon-block-N-- defun that the expression seam hoisted OUT of the lexical let — the #26 gate's subject). Two edits in Pl/PExpr.pm's block-proto branch: (1) ask _v2_embedded_body($block,'sub') first, exactly as the anon-`sub {}` sibling does → lambda_form on the func_ref, hosted at the call site inside the let; (2) when the hook DECLINES — or is absent, which is the case inside the seam's discarded native attempt, since _lower_expr localizes the hook off — ask v1 for a LAMBDA ($return_lambda=1), not a defun. (2) was essential: without it the discarded native parse left a DEAD defun in the bucket whose TEXT still tripped the gate (the last F3 event, S-L-U reduce.t, matched by the gate's sigil-blind scan of live `@a` against the block's `$a`).

Measured: F3 live-v1 CPAN board events 8 -> 0; corpus-diff emission identical across 111 files; gate 131 files/4633 PASS; full sweep 0 new/0 fixed/0 LOST, TOTAL 18498 = baseline; four-dist board identical to the s343 snapshot except S-L-U reduce.t 21 ok/11 -> 23 ok/9 (t25, t32 — v1 defects, both now agree with perl; docs/cpan-scoreboard.tsv edited for that row).

The #26 gate STAYS as an unreached backstop (probed: package stmt / named sub / `use` in the block all lower in place and match perl, so nothing produces a drained defun). Its deletion belongs to E4.1 step 3's reachability pass with the three proofs.

E2.final REMAINDER (unchanged, still E4.1-gated): 310 raw_wrap + ~160 _fallback_stmt/_lower_local echoes + 22 PARSE-ERROR roots + 20 expression raws tied to the v1 statement surface. Deletion of the text printer + raw/raw_wrap happens WITH E4.1 (v1 deletion) / E5.2.
